question: with 20 goals written four ways each, does an existing text representation put the 120 same-content pairs closer than the 120 unrelated pairs -- and do the two distance distributions actually separate, or only look separated under a threshold?

representation_config.R3_policy: used iff the weights are already in the local HuggingFace cache; otherwise unavailable and excluded from the verdict

definition.fixture: OBJECTS x PLACES = 4 x 5 = 20 goals.  Each goal is rendered four ways: describe_goal (entity descriptions) and the three paraphrases needs / hope / state. 80 sentences, 4 per goal, no sentence reused.
definition.same_pair: two distinct wordings of the same (object, place) goal: 20 x C(4,2) = 120.
definition.unrelated_pair: two sentences whose goals differ in object AND place: 120 unrelated goal pairs x 16 sentence pairs = 1,920.  Enumerated completely, not subsampled: picking one rendering per goal would be a template choice made after seeing the fixture.  A cross-goal pair that shares exactly one entity is a near pair (70 goal pairs, 1,120 sentence pairs); near pairs are printed and excluded from the distributions and the verdict.
definition.imbalance: same 120 vs unrelated 1,920.  The AUC and the per-distribution quantiles are defined for unequal counts, and no verdict threshold is applied to the counts themselves.
definition.distance: 1 - cosine for R1/R2/R3 (R1 and R3 are unit vectors; R2 is normalised here).
definition.R1: LivingCoreReference.content_feature: 128-bin byte histogram, L2-normalised, content_centered kept at its default False.  Order-free by construction.
definition.R2: mean over positions of reference.encoder.context(raw), 128 dims.  Weights are the random initialisation of LivingCoreReference(seed=20261031); no gradient step is taken, so this is the untrained encoder, not a learned representation.
definition.R3: instruments.document_embedding.DocumentEmbedder (sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, mean pooling, L2-normalised). Upper bound only.  It is used iff the weights are already in the local HuggingFace cache; no download is attempted and the criteria do not depend on it.
definition.B: character-bigram Jaccard distance, 1 - |A & B| / |A | B|, same pair protocol.
definition.distribution: for each representation both distributions are reported in full: min, p10, p25, median, p75, p90, max, mean, over the frozen 120 same pairs and 120 unrelated pairs.
definition.overlap: three readings per representation: unrelated pairs at or below p90(same); same pairs at or above p10(unrelated); histogram overlap coefficient sum_i min(s_i/n_s, u_i/n_u) over 15 equal-width bins spanning the pooled range.  Overlap is reported next to accuracy because a high accuracy can come from a threshold that happens to sit in the middle.
definition.classification: leave-one-out 1-NN over the 80 sentences: a sentence is correct iff its nearest other sentence belongs to the same goal.  Cosine distance, ties broken by smaller index.
definition.gap: p10(unrelated) - p90(same); positive means the central bands do not overlap.
definition.auc: Mann-Whitney P(distance(same) < distance(unrelated)), ties counted as 0.5.
definition.verdict_order: R1, R2 and B decide the overall verdict; R3 is an upper bound and never decides it.  All three overlaps -> representation_not_supported; R1 separates and R2 overlaps -> lexical_overlap_only; R2 separates -> representation_supported_without_training; otherwise inconclusive.

criteria.C1_freeze: the manifest is written before the first reading with the runner sha, the three fixture file hashes, the pair definitions and the verdict thresholds; the run refuses to start if a fixture file changed after the freeze.
criteria.C2_counts: 80 sentences, 120 same pairs, 1,920 unrelated pairs, 1,120 near pairs; every pair is flagged same, unrelated or near before any distance is computed.
criteria.C3_distributions: for R1, R2, B and (when cached) R3 both distributions are printed with the seven quantiles, the AUC, the gap and the three overlap readings.
criteria.C4_classification: leave-one-out 1-NN accuracy is reported on the same 80 sentences.
criteria.C5_verdict: per representation separates iff gap > 0 and AUC >= 0.95 and 1-NN >= 0.90; overlaps iff gap <= 0 or AUC < 0.90; otherwise inconclusive.  The overall verdict follows the frozen order and is not revisited after the reading.
criteria.C6_no_fit: 0 training, 0 optimizer steps, 0 Adam, 0 confirm, 0 new parameters; the only tensors allocated are the random-initialised reference and the frozen cached model.

cost_estimate.note: 80 sentences x 2 encoders (128 dims, ~20 bytes each) + 3,160 pair distances + 4 x 80x80 matrices; the reference is constructed once.  Below the 200 CPU cap.
